text:
Mid-morning, waiting areas stood out in your honest letter, and we are sorry that your journey with Aurelia Skyways and the Companion Animal Travel Desk did not meet the standard you were entitled to expect. You reported that the assistance offered around your companion animal was slow, the boarding process felt disorganised, and the follow-up after the disruption was not handled with the care and clarity that should have been provided.

We recognise that travel with an animal requires careful planning, calm communication, and dependable support from the first point of contact through arrival. Our guidance is intended to help passengers prepare well in advance, and our team should reinforce that guidance with respectful, practical assistance at every stage. When delays or missed connections affect a journey, the situation must be reviewed promptly so that the traveler receives a clear explanation and the appropriate next steps. <<FACT F110>> We understand that such interruptions can be especially difficult when a companion animal is involved, and we regret any added stress this caused.

We also note your concern about the handling of the crate and the information shared after arrival. In cases where a crate is reported missing, the matter must be recorded carefully and addressed through the proper claim process without delay. <<FACT F118>> The desk expects staff to respond with accuracy, patience, and courtesy, and we are reviewing whether those standards were met in your case.

Your complaint has been passed to the relevant service leads for review, including the team responsible for animal travel safety and customer recovery. They will examine the handling of your trip, the communication you received, and the points where service may have fallen short. We value the opportunity to correct such failures, and we will use your account to reinforce training, strengthen oversight, and improve the consistency of support offered to future travelers. We regret the inconvenience and concern you experienced, and we remain committed to restoring your confidence in Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
